name: blender
description: Drive a running Blender — inspect the scene, run bpy Python, see the viewport. Pairs with the bundled Sapphire Link addon (see README for the one-time Blender-side install).
author: sapphire

settings.label: Blender host
settings.help: Where the Sapphire Link addon is listening. Leave as localhost unless you know why.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: Must match the port in the addon preferences (Blender > Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Sapphire Link).

settings.label: Call timeout (sec)
settings.help: How long a blender_code call may run (renders and heavy ops take a while).

settings.label: Viewport snapshot max dimension (px)
settings.help: Long-edge cap for blender_see images. Lower = fewer vision tokens.
